parts.text: We are creating studio portraits for team member 'gulsiye-begum-gumus' in a multi-turn conversation. First, here are ALL available original reference photographs of this exact person (4 unique photos):
Reference photo — Original photo (gulsiye-begum-gumus-canva.jpg) / Canva raw image (071e44f5-696b-408f-a22c-3fb29ea96222.jpg):
Here is the framing-corrected portrait (`kadraj`) of this person where their original face is 100% preserved and the head-and-shoulders framing is centered with headroom:
And here is our target medium-grey studio backdrop reference (`bilgehan-zeki-ozaytac.jpg` — note the medium-grey seamless studio background with subtle vignette and clean studio lighting):

TASK 1 (Natural Medium-Grey Studio Portrait / Gri Fon): Using the framing-corrected portrait and all original reference photos of this person above, produce a natural head-and-shoulders studio portrait on a flat medium-grey studio background matching Bilgehan's studio backdrop (NOT pure white, NOT black). IMPORTANT:
1. NO stiff biometric/ID rules: preserve the person's natural head angle, posture, authentic expression/smile, hairstyle or headscarf wrap, glasses (if worn), and clothing from their framing-corrected photo.
2. Keep their face 100% faithful to the real person—do NOT beautify, smooth skin texture, slim the face, change eye/nose/lip/eyebrow shape, or alter age.
3. Head-and-shoulders framing with comfortable headroom above the hair/headscarf and both shoulders visible. If a hand is raised to the face/hair in a selfie, remove/lower the hand cleanly.
4. Soft, even professional studio lighting on the subject that matches the medium-grey backdrop, sharp focus across the subject, no shallow depth-of-field blur, no text or logos. 
Person details: Wearing a grey silk headscarf with white border stripes, sunglasses resting on top of head (remove top sunglasses for vesikalik, keep for gri-fon if natural), burgundy/maroon sweater, warm smile.
